label: VERIFIED
extraction: Agent Teams AI peer review and structured messaging. Kanban board as single source of truth: agents pull tasks (Backlog -> In Progress -> Review -> Done). Task ownership via lock with timestamp and agent ID. State transitions only forward; backward requires human approval or peer review rejection. Full board visibility for all agents. Structured messaging between agents. Peer review: agents review each other's output. Avoids 'who does what' ambiguity and cascading failures. Framework (1,740 stars, 303 forks) supports 200+ models across 75+ LLM providers. Treats coordination as first-class concern, not afterthought. TypeScript orchestration framework.
